practicalScale.rule: Use the middle value for a meaningful but non-defining burden or benefit; avoid false numeric precision.

professionIdentityRules: Assign only when the official name or source text explicitly presents the archetype as that profession or vocation.
Do not infer a profession from a skill rank, class skill or thematic resemblance alone.
Store the supporting source excerpt and source reference with every assigned profession value.
Allow multiple values when the source explicitly supports them.

constraintKinds.requirement: Determines whether the option can legally be selected.
constraintKinds.commitment: Does not normally block selection, but creates an ongoing behavioural, build or narrative obligation.
constraintKinds.theme: Describes identity without imposing a material mechanical restriction.
